description: The plot illustrates the Accuracy on the BBQ task across a varying number of demonstrations for four different configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks at intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 45 to 55 at intervals of 5. The "Squared-Exponential" configuration is represented by a dark blue solid line with circular markers; it starts at an accuracy of approximately 53 at near 25 demonstrations, rises to a peak of roughly 56.2 at 1000 demonstrations, and ends at approximately 56.2 at 1500 demonstrations. The "Tanh" configuration is shown as a medium blue solid line with circular markers, beginning at an accuracy of about 48.2 near 25 demonstrations, experiencing a slight dip to approximately 47.9 at 750 demonstrations, and concluding at roughly 48.1 at 1500 demonstrations. The "ELU" configuration is depicted by a light blue solid line with circular markers, maintaining a steady trend that starts at approximately 46.3 near 25 demonstrations and ends at roughly 46.5 at 1500 demonstrations. Finally, the "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" configuration is represented by a pink dash-dot line without markers, which remains constant at an accuracy of approximately 43 across the entire x-axis range from 0 to 1500 demonstrations.
